name: EPIC 246061013
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 11.5 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246061013 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.504381 (16th-84th percentiles 11.144479-12.012344), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,788 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.89 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,569 K at its surface.
